Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

• Some hooks are rags.

• All rags are bottles.

(I) Some bottles are hooks.

(II) All bottles are rags.
questions.solution:

(I) Some bottles are hooks → **True**(As Some hooks are rags, All rags are bottles. so, Some bottles are hooks holds true)

(II) All bottles are rags → False(As, All rags are bottles, so, All bottles are rags can be a possibility but definite)

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

27 - 45 x 15 ÷ 8 + 3 = 6
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question:

Now,

Given equation: 27 - 45 × 15 ÷ 8 + 3 = 6

**1) Interchange - and ×**

New equation: 27 × 45 - 15 ÷ 8 + 3 = ?

Perform operations according to BODMAS

⇒ __**27 × 45**__ - 15 ÷ 8 + 3

⇒ 1215 - __**15 ÷ 8**__ + 3

⇒ __**1215 - 1.87**__ + 3

⇒ __**1213.12 + 3**__

⇒ 1216.12 ≠ 6 (Incorrect)

**2) Interchange + and ×**

New equation: 27 - 45 + 15 ÷ 8 × 3 = ?

Perform operations according to BODMAS

⇒ 27 - 45 + __**15 ÷ 8**__ × 3

⇒ 27 - 45 + __**1.87 × 3**__

⇒ __**27 - 45**__ + 5.62

⇒ __**-18 + 5.62**__

⇒ -12.37 ≠ 6 (Incorrect)

**3) Interchange ÷ and ×**

New equation: 27 - 45 ÷ 15 × 8 + 3 = ?

Perform operations according to BODMAS

⇒ 27 - __**45 ÷ 15**__ × 8 + 3

⇒ 27 - __**3 × 8**__ + 3

⇒ __**27 - 24**__ + 3

⇒ __**3 + 3**__

6 = 6 (Correct)

**4) Interchange - and +**

New equation: 27 + 45 × 15 ÷ 8 - 3 = ?

Perform operations according to BODMAS

⇒ 27 + __**45 × 15**__ ÷ 8 - 3

⇒ 27 + __**675 ÷ 8**__ - 3

⇒ __**27 + 84.37**__ - 3

⇒ __**111.37 - 3**__

⇒ 108.37 ≠ 6 (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

140 × 2 – 4 ÷ 56 + 82 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, the signs are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Symbol
 +
 −
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 New Symbol
 −
 +
 ÷
 ×
 
 

Now,

Given expression: 140 × 2 – 4 ÷ 56 + 82 = ?

After interchanging the specified signs:

⇒ 140 ÷ 2 + 4 × 56 – 82

Perform operations according to BODMAS

⇒ __**140 ÷ 2**__ + 4 × 56 – 82

⇒ 70 + __**4 × 56**__ – 82

⇒ __**70 + 224**__ – 82

⇒ __**294 – 82**__

⇒ 212

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some metals are iron.

Some iron are steel.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some metals are steel.

(II) All steel are iron.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e9e41e37b6375155d6dd4fbc106edfe942605c5303d33adbe1761f9a5685970.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some metals are steel → False( As, there is no direct relation between metals and steel. so, it can be a possibility but not define)

(II) All steel are iron → False(As, Some iron are steel. so, All steel are iron can be a possibility but not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
